tei:div.tei:p: (cha)༄༅// dam tshig rdo rje'i sgom bzlas bya tshul tshigs bcad dag byed bdud rtsi'i khrus chab ces bya ba bzhugs// na mo gu ru/ bla ma lha la gus btud nas// dam tshig rdo rje'i sgom bzlas kyis// rang gzhan sdig ltung dag byed bshad// skyabs sems sngon du btang byas te// rang nyid yi dam lhar gsal ba'i// thugs kar sna tshogs pad rdo rje'i// lte bar hā las ral gri hās// mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las// dpal ldan dam tshig rdo rje dang*// yum mchog dam tshig sgrol ma bcas// margad mdog can mdzes pa'i sku// gnyis ka ljang nag dkar gsum gyi// zhal dang phyag drug yab kyi g.yas// ral gri sna tshogs rdo rje dang*// 'khor lo g.yon pas rim pa bzhin// dril bu pad ljang nor bu 'dzin// yum gyi g.yas pa'i phyag gsum na// sna tshogs rdo rje 'khor lo dang*// rdo rjes mtshan pa'i ut+pal// g.yon gsum dril bu rin chen dang*// ral gri 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud// yab yum gnas gsum 'bru gsum gyi// 'od kyis ye shes dbang lhar bcas// spyan drangs dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥyis// dam tshig ye shes gnyis med gyur// dbang lhas dbang bskur rigs kyi bdag /yab la mi bskyod yum gyi dbur// don yod grub pas brgyan par gyur// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ don yod rdo rje rdzogs sangs rgyas// bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa// dag pa ngo bo nyid las byung*// dam tshig rdo rje la phyag 'tshal// thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng gi /'od zer 'phro 'dus rang gzhan gyi// dam tshig nyams chag ma lus pa// byang zhing dag pa nyid du gyur// oṃ āḥpradzñā dhṛ?ka hā hūm̐/ zhes pa ci 'grub bzlas pa'i mthar// bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa yis// dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams// bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste// thugs rje chen po bdag nyid can// 'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi// dam tshig rdo rje'i zhal nas kyang*// khyod kyi dam tshig nyams chag kun// byang zhing dag go zhes gsungs nas// rang la thim pas sku gsung thugs/

dbyer med rang bzhin gcig tu gyur// smras pa/ dam tshig rdo rje'i bzlas bsgom gyi// nyams len tshigs su bcad pa'i dges// gsang sngags lam gyi mi mthun phyogs// nyams chag ma lus dag gyur cig /ces shākya'i btsun pa mang thos blo gsal bstan skyong gis dpal zhwa lu ri phug gi byang gling sgrub khang du bris pa ste rje btsun bla ma dngul chu ba'i gsung la gzhan dag gis tshigs bcad 'bri rogs zhes bskul ba'i ngor byas pa'o// //sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
